metadata.description: The Kadal Store for AI agents: find assets for the project you are in, download what you own into it, and get a link to buy the rest.

plugins.name: kadal-store
plugins.description: Use the Kadal Store (store.kadal.cc) with your own account: the kadal-store skill (finding assets for the current project, downloading into it, buy links that never charge, reporting problems in purchased files) and the kadal-store MCP server (search, recommend, library, download_to_folder, project_summary, create_buy_link, report_problem).
